list.title: Tenants
list.description: The customers of this deployment. Each tenant is a hard wall around its data; making one invites its first administrator.

create.title: New tenant
create.description: Makes the tenant with its roles. The first administrator gets an invitation if the address has no account yet.
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: A short handle: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.
create.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters and digits, with single dashes between (at most 48 characters).
create.emailHint: An account at this address is made and invited when there is none.
create.done: Tenant {{name}} created. {{email}} is its first administrator.

conflict.title: This tenant changed
conflict.description: Another operator changed it since you opened it. Reload it to see the current values, then make your change again.

name.title: Name and slug
name.description: The name is what people see. The slug is the tenant's short handle.
name.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes. Anything that refers to the tenant by its slug must use the new one.

state.title: Access
state.activeDescription: The tenant is active. Deactivating ends its members' sessions and stops its API keys; nothing is deleted.
state.inactiveDescription: The tenant is inactive: nobody can sign in to it and its API keys and jobs are stopped. Its data is kept.
state.operatorTenant: This is the operator tenant. It is never deactivated: the operators would lock themselves out.
state.deactivateDescription: Its members are signed out of it, its API keys and invitations stop working, and its jobs are skipped. Nothing is deleted: reactivating gives everything back, but its members must sign in again.
state.reactivateDescription: Its data, members and API keys are back. Its members sign in again.
state.failed: The change did not go through. Try again.
state.deletionPending: A deletion is pending: cancel it (under Delete tenant) before reactivating.
state.deletionStarted: The tenant is being erased. It can no longer be reactivated.

export.title: Export
export.description: Every record of this tenant as one file, made in the background. The download link works for 30 minutes. Asks for a recent sign-in.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass
breakGlass.description: Read this tenant without its invitation, for an emergency. Read only, one hour at most, never extended. The tenant's administrators are told at once. Asks for a recent sign-in.
breakGlass.none: You have not opened this tenant.
breakGlass.activeHint: While it lasts, GET requests sent with this header read the tenant and nothing can be written there:
breakGlass.endDescription: Requests through this grant stop at once.
breakGlass.dialogDescription: You will read this tenant, read only. Your reason is kept in both tenants' audit logs and told to its administrators.
breakGlass.reasonHint: An incident or a ticket, 10 to 1000 characters.
breakGlass.reasonInvalid: Give a reason of 10 to 1000 characters.
breakGlass.minutesInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, 1 to 60.

deletion.title: Delete tenant
deletion.description: Deactivates the tenant now and erases all of its data after a grace period. Export it first if you need a copy.
deletion.confirmDescription: The tenant is deactivated now: its members are signed out and its API keys stop. After the grace period every record, file, job and workflow of it is erased for good. Until then you can cancel the deletion.
deletion.mismatch: That is not the tenant's slug.
deletion.scheduledHint: The tenant is deactivated. Cancel the deletion to keep it; it then stays deactivated until you reactivate it.
deletion.cancelled: Deletion of {{name}} cancelled. The tenant stays deactivated.
deletion.startedHint: The erase has started and can no longer be cancelled.
